entries.grounds: MV@4ec961e confirms the mutant changes only L1077, inside the `except OSError:` arm of migrate's read-back (:1074-1077). This arm runs only if a.out.read_bytes() raises OSError immediately after the exclusive _create wrote the file at :1072 — a defensive I/O-failure guard. The success-path assignment at :1075 that every reader observes is unmutated; the None-on-failure fallback is undocumented (docstring:79, report prose:443 describe file_sha256 as the success value). No registered kill file, doc scenario, or operator misuse reaches the branch (no test monkeypatches read_bytes to raise); migrate's main try/except does not even catch a generic OSError, so the branch is purely the read-back guard. Not EQUIVALENT (observable inside the branch); AUDITED — unreachable in tests and a test would be artificial coverage of an I/O-failure guard, which the round forbids. Effect: `report['candidate']['file_sha256']=None` -> `report['candidate']['']=None` (the file_sha256 key would be absent under an OSError).
